KANJAY CONSULTING / ESTABLISHED 2014

HR support.
GeM seller guidance.

For small and medium businesses: HR support globally and GeM portal consulting for sellers across India.

Let’s talk
↗
Explore our services
01 / FOR EMPLOYERS · GLOBAL SUPPORT
HR support
↗
02 / FOR SELLERS · ACROSS INDIA
GeM seller support
↗

GeM consulting since 2018.

OUR SERVICES

Two paths.
Support around your needs.

01 / FOR EMPLOYERS · GLOBAL SUPPORT

HR support

Support for the people and processes behind your business.

HR Audit & HR Process Setup
↗

We review existing processes, records and documentation, identify gaps and establish practical HR systems that support your business as it grows.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
↗

We support job descriptions, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination and selection follow-ups to make hiring more structured and efficient.

Payroll & Statutory Compliance
↗

Simplify monthly payroll with coordinated attendance inputs, salary calculations and payslip preparation. We also support applicable statutory compliance activities and coordinate with your finance team or compliance specialists.

View HR support summaries
↗

02 / FOR SELLERS · ACROSS INDIA

GeM seller support

Guidance for businesses working through the Government e-Marketplace portal.

Seller Registration & Profile Setup
↗

We assist with registration, document coordination and profile setup to showcase your business on the portal.

Bid Search & Analysis
↗

We review relevant bids, eligibility criteria, technical requirements and submission timelines to help you make informed participation decisions.

Order & Contract Support
↗

We assist with order acceptance, contract requirement tracking, delivery coordination and portal invoicing, helping you manage commitments and follow-ups.

View GeM seller support summaries
↗

Looking for a role? Recruitment also supports candidates. Email hr@kanjayconsulting.com.

OUR WORKING APPROACH

Agreed around
your business.

We work with clients through mutually agreed approaches to their business needs.

Our HR work includes reviewing processes and records, coordinating recruitment and supporting payroll inputs. For GeM sellers, our work includes document coordination, bid reviews and portal follow-ups.

Discuss your needs by email
↗

WHAT GUIDES US

Trust. Quality. Support.
Trust

Trust as the foundation of communication and client relationships.

Quality

A commitment to quality in the work we do.

Support

Back-office support and long-term client relationships.

EXPERIENCE & RELATIONSHIPS

Working with businesses.
Since 2014.

HR support globally. GeM seller consulting across India since 2018.

A selection of our clients
